name: kiasumiles
description: Hosted Singapore credit-card miles recommendations for the cards you choose.

interface.shortDescription: Ask Codex which Singapore miles card to use at a merchant.
interface.longDescription: KiasuMiles checks the cards you choose against its hosted card rules and merchant data. Your agent supplies those cards for each lookup; the hosted service does not store a wallet.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use KiasuMiles to help me choose the best card for a Singapore merchant.
